decision.message: The esp32_bmp280_v1 board family only supports an external regulated power input in the range 3.2 V to 3.4 V. Supplying 5 V DC directly on the power connector is outside the supported voltage envelope and would damage the board or cause malfunction. Please provide a regulated supply in the supported voltage range.

clauses.text: The board has to accept 5 V DC directly on its power connector.
clauses.reason: Accepting 5 V DC directly on the power connector is not supported; the board requires a regulated 3.2–3.4 V supply. No USB data interface is consistent with the board.

clauses.text: I do not need USB data.
clauses.reason: The board has no USB interface and does not provide USB data; hence, not needing USB data is supported.
